title: Antigravity human-message extraction with exclusions
description: Implement extract() for the Antigravity adapter per the research counting rule: human messages only; skip harness-injected content, agent/model output, tool calls, and system records with skip counters; timestamps normalized to RFC 3339 UTC; stable dedup keys. Done when: extraction tests pass on synthetic fixtures including injected and malformed shapes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done. extract() queries steps WHERE step_type = 14 ORDER BY idx and decodes the schema-less protobuf with a self-contained minimal reader (src/sentiment/adapters/antigravity.ts): user text from field 19.2 (parts list 19.3 never read — it concatenates to 19.2 and would double-count), artifact attach sends detected via field 19.7 and skipped, timestamps from field 5.1.1 seconds + 5.1.2 nanos normalized to RFC 3339 UTC, recordId '<conversation-uuid>:<idx>'. All other step types (15/132/23/101/17/0 = agent output and bookkeeping) are never selected. Unreadable DBs and unparseable payloads feed skipCounter.failedFiles/malformedLines, never fatal. Tests cover text extraction, attach skips, malformed counting, nested-cascade exclusion, and meter integration. Verified live: 448 human messages all-time (6 thanks tokens, 24 f-bomb tokens).
